summary:
Garage door shuddering, hanging crooked, or sitting outside its track? In Miami, that usually means it's time to stop and call, not to keep trying the opener. Running the motor against a jammed door can push it further out of position, and forcing a roller back in while the springs are under tension can cause serious injury.

While you wait, keep people and pets clear and take photos of the tracks and rollers. They help the technician and may be needed if you file an insurance claim.

The 305 Doors blog explains the warning signs, the common causes, from bumped tracks to humidity and salt-air corrosion, and how to tell when a repair makes sense and when replacement is the better path. 305 Doors handles garage door repair and installation across Miami-Dade.
